name: Lin Yuanzhou
description: A newly minted apprentice of the Tide-Reader Guild — cautious, yet insatiably curious. Since his examination he has been preoccupied; ask him and he says he slept badly.

fields.condition: Fit, but tense after the deep-withdrawal alert

name: Su Yao
description: A fully qualified Tide-Reader, Old Qi's assistant, and the examiner for the player's entrance trial. Meticulous to a fault — and since Qi vanished, she has begun to doubt everything she once believed.

fields.condition: Sleepless, but still holding herself under control

name: Iron Meg
description: Second-in-command of the Salt Fangs, past thirty. Her left arm, from the elbow down, was lost to fog-rot in a relic accident — half-translucent now, glowing a faint grey. Cold and hard, but true to her word; she pays far too much for relic fragments for it to be mere business.

fields.fogRotSigns: Left arm translucent below the elbow, glowing grey in damp air
fields.condition: Old injury stable; fine movement in the left hand is limited
fields.dispositionToPlayer: Appraising — can be swayed by the rules and sincerity

name: Chen Yuanshan
description: Chair of the Mistport Council, past sixty, a master of statecraft. In public he pushes the Tide-Seal Decree in the name of public safety; in private he sends his own expeditions deep into the Undertow, again and again.

fields.dispositionToPlayer: Instrumental appraisal — courts you if you're useful

name: Old Qi
description: Guildmaster of the Tide-Readers, a gentle white-haired scholar who understands the Riftide better than anyone living, and has lately taken to wearing gloves. Before the story opens he leaves a letter and walks into the Undertow at flood tide — and vanishes.

fields.dispositionToPlayer: If reunited, will see the player as one who can be entrusted with the truth

name: Frost
description: The youngest Mist-Speaker of the Congregation of the Mist — no more than fifteen or sixteen. She claims to hear the whispers of the fog, and has more than once foretold ebb times and ruin sites exactly. Prophet, madwoman, or fraud?

fields.tideSense: Extreme (revered by the Congregation as a miracle)
fields.fogRotSigns: Fingertips sometimes shine through; she calls it a 'blessing'
fields.condition: Unnaturally cold; long listening spells leave her briefly absent
fields.dispositionToPlayer: A strange, familiar closeness — riddles in her words

name: Grey Falcon
description: Captain of Chen Yuanshan's private expedition and the sharpest hand enforcing the Tide-Seal Decree. Silent, efficient, without a wasted emotion; his latest quarry points toward the direction in which Old Qi vanished.

fields.location: Between Mid-Harbor and the Undertow (on patrol)
fields.condition: Fit, after twelve continuous hours on duty
fields.dispositionToPlayer: Hostile by default — may soften over a shared question
